title: RAW UNREVIEWED: f88r rows branch from one input or form a serial chain
summary: The admitted f88r page has three illustrated material rows, three prose blocks and sixteen local label groups. IDEA645 already contrasts one serial process with independent entries; this narrower alternative asks whether two later rows are parallel outputs of one earlier material, rather than consecutive transformations. Freeze all three row and label owners and complete prose first. A branch reading must identify one written precursor reused by both later records and two distinct result owners; a chain reading must instead identify the first later result as input to the last. Repeated common forms, vessel similarity and a generic historical process are insufficient. If neither a written source identity nor result ownership can be fixed, record missing capacity, not a positive match.

design.mechanism: one owned precursor supports two result branches instead of a result-to-input serial handoff
design.unit: all three admitted f88r image rows, sixteen local labels and complete associated prose blocks
design.contrast: parallel products with common written input versus ordered chain with intermediate product reused
design.prediction: a frozen whole reading assigns the same earlier input to two distinct results without assigning either result as the other branch's input; ambiguous participant ownership blocks testing
